objective: Show immediate, accessible progress while a profile route loads and remove the unexplained delay between URL navigation and visible profile content.
acceptance_criteria: Before implementation, measure a cold and a warm navigation to a profile route, identify whether route chunk loading, profile data or another step accounts for the delay, and record the evidence in the PR.

When the requested profile is not yet ready, the route immediately shows a visible, accessible loading state rather than leaving the previous page visible with no feedback. The loading state is announced appropriately to assistive technology and does not move focus unexpectedly.

When profile data becomes ready, the loading state is replaced by the correct own or public profile. A route transition never displays stale content from the previously viewed page as if it belonged to the requested profile.

A failed profile load replaces the progress state with the existing error/retry treatment; loading does not remain indefinitely. Repeated navigation and browser back/forward continue to show the requested profile.
Use the existing loading/skeleton patterns and design tokens. Respect reduced-motion preferences, keyboard use and screen-reader status; no raw colour or pixel font sizes in module CSS.
Tests cover a deferred profile response, immediate loading feedback, correct replacement on success, error/retry and navigation between two profile routes without stale content.

Browser rows at 360 and 1280 CSS px, light and dark, reported with evidence or NOT DONE: cold profile navigation with delayed data, warm navigation, back/forward, and 200% text size. Include before/after time from URL navigation to meaningful profile content; there is no numeric performance SLO in this spec.
No new dependency or API change. Existing profile data, access and caching behavior remain unchanged.
wiki/CodeContext/Modules/0x08-frontend.md records the profile loading behavior if it changes.
